An ambiguous organization reference must carry at least two candidates: with one candidate it is resolved, not ambiguous. A candidate organization and a candidate label naming that organization count as one candidate (ADR-0026, ADR-0039).
A reference carries resolvedTo exactly when its status is rstat:resolved (ADR-0031).
The resolution status is not admissible for the referential kind of this reference (ADR-0031).

A coding activity carries at least one qualified association naming the agent that coded; each association has exactly one agent and at most one plan (PROV-DM; ADR-0033, ADR-0040).

In NuProc data every software coder is a language model that followed a prompt specification, so a coding activity carried out by a software agent records that prompt specification as a plan of a qualified association (ADR-0003, ADR-0040).
The organization that bears a role realized in an engagement participates in that engagement (RO has participant; ADR-0040).
